sections.title: Explanation
sections.content: A simple address can be given as street name + *utca* + house number.

Hungarian addresses read the opposite way from what you might expect: street name, then utca (‘street’), then the number — Kossuth utca 10, never ‘10 Kossuth utca.’ If you’re ever giving your address out loud, lead with the name and let the number trail at the end, exactly like the example shows.
